title: JESUS IS KING
description: The official artwork for JESUS IS KING is an image of the album's vinyl disc, a parallel to Yandhi's planned album cover. It features the bright blue hue that has been connected to the album throughout its promotion. This cover has an indirect correlation to some of Ye's previous work, particularly Yeezus. "AR 1331 A" is apparently the "Archer Records (AR) pressing plant code" assigned to a 1970 Detroit gospel single. However, unlike the original record, the vinyl changed "45 RPM EP" to "33 RPM LP."

source_claims.value: Release ready version of the song. Almost identical to the SNL 40 version, but now with Frank Ocean on the intro and different production on Sia's verse, as well as one less line on her verse compared to previous versions. Meant for the now scrapped A Side / B Side single release of "All Day" & "Wolves", which was meant to release on February 24th, 2015 based on Ye's iTunes Artist Page updating, Joe Perez's single art, MIKE DEAN hyping it up on Twitter and Benji B being confused by it's delay on Twitter. Was delayed by a week for unknown reasons and the next release day of March 3rd, 2015, "All Day" released on it's own without "Wolves". Song was purchased from MUSICMAFIA by a Section80 user and eventually leaked in the Feb 2016 leak season.
